introHtml: Glass nail files and manicure tools offer a hygienic, reusable alternative to disposable emery boards. Unlike metal files, glass surfaces are gentle on nails and can be sanitized easily, making them ideal for corporate gift sets or spa-branded giveaways. Customize with your logo for a polished, professional look that recipients will use daily.
